Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume. Short midface, soft gently rounded jawline, small soft chin, natural-sized open eyes; no long, pointed or heavy jaw. Golden blonde hair and olive skin. Costume palette: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade. Her costume reads master strategist scholarly prestige at first glance: elegant, layered, finely ornamented, flagship-card detail. One figure only, no other person, horse or creature. One head, two naturally joined arms and two legs, both hands visible with five natural fingers each. Bold exposure by design: deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, high slit or short hem; intimate areas covered. Full body from crown to both boots inside the frame with modest headroom and clear space below the boots; figure occupies about four-fifths image height, chest-height camera, natural portrait perspective, no wide angle, low angle or close crop. Hands and signature item stay inside the frame. No text, logo or watermark.

YEAR 2190 MECHA: Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon, glass-domed garden-city research dock, ringed gas giant in the sky, orbital elevator, green starship docks. Human face and hair on a female mecha personification. Face: small soft oval, open aquamarine eyes, neat curved brows, short nose, soft rounded lips, restrained eyeliner, calmly curious expression. Golden blonde hair in a high sculpted ponytail with short side-swept fringe. Costume shape 3: long coat made entirely of rigid armor plates from shoulders to below knees, open at front to show body armor and angular collar. Solid hard-surface mecha plates, visible thickness, joints, panel lines and green glow lines; no fabric or gown. Jade-green and white-jade plates, imperial-gold trim and earthen-brown alloy joints. Signature construction: interlocking sliding gear-rack plates allow the armored coat tails to extend like a telescoping lever assembly, scholarly prestigious geometry and fine technical engraving. Bare upper arms and midriff, covered intimate areas, all remaining body armored. She holds one full-scale futuristic gear-and-lever apparatus before her body: alloy plates, precise mechanical joints, vents, emitter nodes and glowing green core, no wood or silk. Both hands support the apparatus, frontal stance with small relaxed turn, feet visible. Far-future structures only, no traditional East-Asian buildings or hanzi. Bright orbital daylight and luminous rim.
